origin: Root proposed a proper-overlap letter writer. Producer reviewed the algebra and prior reports/code without native payloads, source encoding, image access or a new count. Root owns any binding/replay of the old certificates.

contract.codewords: Every source letter has one fixed nonempty finite string over the22working units. The first codeword of a complete source word is written in full.
contract.join: For adjacent ORIGINAL codewords U,V choose a common suffix/prefix overlap of length k with 0<=k<min(|U|,|V|). Retain the current output unchanged and append V[k:]. No previous visible prefix is erased. Visible word boundaries are preserved.
contract.scope_of_overlap: The theorem works for any chosen legal proper overlap, not only the maximal one. The stated length bound is against both adjacent original codewords, not a retrospectively redefined whole accumulated output.
contract.content: The proposed writer must be injective on all nonempty source-word sequences. No semantic equivalences, excluded repeated inputs, hidden marks, deletions or context-dependent codewords are supplied.
contract.two_distinct_entry_hypotheses: Explicit distinct initial working units is one hypothesis. Merely at most22entries is weaker and implies it only if22distinct ORIGINAL whole-word initial units are separately witnessed.

singleton_transfer.first_code: At a group beginning, the first full code remains a prefix of the final output because subsequent joins only append. With distinct code initials, its first working unit identifies which source code must begin.
singleton_transfer.inductive_hypothesis: All codes already assigned by the old derivation are proved one-unit codes. Parse each observed group from its beginning through the longest prefix made only of those forced singleton units.
singleton_transfer.no_overlap_at_forced_boundary: Any overlap touching one of those singleton codewords has k<1, hence k=0. Thus the consumed prefix consists of whole separate singleton codes, and the next unassigned code starts in full at the exact remaining position.
singleton_transfer.next_forcing: Every reached remainder with first unit g must begin with the same complete C_g. If their common prefix has length1, or one is exactly g, then C_g=g. This is a necessary conclusion for every completion of the overlap table.
singleton_transfer.iteration: Apply the same argument to every successive one-option singleton step. If all22heads are obtained, every used code is singleton and every proper overlap is zero. The writer reduces to ordinary one-sign substitution under its unknown letter naming.
singleton_transfer.old_certificate_requirement: GDT1233 REPORT explicitly states that every visited native node had a one-option domain and no speculative longer-code branch was needed. Root must bind/replay precisely those chains: preceding assigned codes must all be singletons; each new domain must contain only its singleton; old source leaves, whole-group boundaries and unit tuples remain fixed.
singleton_transfer.not_a_blanket_solver_transfer: A general1233branch contradiction involving previously assigned longer codes cannot automatically be reused. Ordinary concatenation and proper-overlap outputs then differ. The positive counterexample below proves that the old overall verdict alone would not suffice.

counterexample_to_blanket_transfer.rule: Take maximal proper overlap. Equal consecutive codewords share one sign; unequal codewords share zero.
counterexample_to_blanket_transfer.all_source_word_inverse: Each maximal source run X^r or Y^r becomes one output run of the corresponding sign of length r+1. Every output run has length>=2. Subtract1 from each run length to recover the source word uniquely. Thus this is injective for ALL finite nonempty source words.
counterexample_to_blanket_transfer.overlap_cover: X,XX,Y,YY respectively produce these four words.
counterexample_to_blanket_transfer.concatenation_comparison: A distinct-initial ordinary-concatenation table covering both aa and aaa must have a-headed code a: aa as a longer code cannot tile aaa, and b-headed codes would introduce b. Similarly the b-headed code must be b. The ordinary identity-only conclusion therefore does not itself exclude this proper-overlap table.
counterexample_to_blanket_transfer.role: Pure mathematical control, no native words, sounds or meanings. It is not selected as a new writer or offered as a repair.

arbitrary_heads_and_reader_scope.supplied_by_root_not_recounted: Root reports from already computed1293initial_groups: RF has22original first-unit types; IT21with n absent; ZL20with n,m absent. RF n and m each have one initial-group witness.
arbitrary_heads_and_reader_scope.RF_bridge: Conditional on those bound RF witnesses, the first-code-whole rule requires at least one code entry beginning with every one of the22units. With at most22entries, there are exactly22entries and their initials are distinct. The singleton-transfer argument can then apply.
arbitrary_heads_and_reader_scope.other_readers: The at-most22capacity alone does not establish distinct initials in IT/ZL. Do not pool RF's initial witnesses with another reader's stronger chains. Under an EXPLICIT distinct-initial code contract, the old one-option chains can be applied separately to all three readings.
arbitrary_heads_and_reader_scope.inactive_or_unused_codes: Unused code entries or unobserved heads do not explain actual redundancy. Initial coverage and activity must be stated on the exact same frozen representation and population.
arbitrary_heads_and_reader_scope.fragility: Rare first-head and forcing witnesses are conditional transcription evidence, not independently proven glyphs. Their rarity is retained rather than corrected away.

full_overlap_collision.self: If maximal full self-overlap is allowed, a code C_X overlaps all of itself. Source X and XX both write C_X, contradicting all-source-word injectivity.
full_overlap_collision.either_side: More generally, if a join of U=C_X and V=C_Y uses k=|U|, then U is a prefix of V and XY writes V, colliding with Y. If k=|V|, XY writes U, colliding with X. Thus any actually allowed full absorption of either adjacent code creates a two-letter-versus-one-letter collision under the unrestricted source domain.
full_overlap_collision.limits: A source grammar forbidding the colliding input, an added marker or an admitted ambiguity would change the contract. None is adopted here.

primary_predecessors.retained: All used codes singleton under ordinary concatenation/distinct initials; every native visited domain one-option. Only that stronger certificate structure supports the present induction.
General backtracking allows longer assigned codes; those branches are not automatically valid overlap branches.

primary_predecessors.distinction: Each WRITTEN symbol there denotes a fixed latent pair/block and adjacent written symbols overlap in latent coordinates, at fixed length/advance. The proposed channel maps SOURCE letters to variable written strings and coalesces their written suffix/prefix. Neither883's equality graph nor its homophony bound is imported as this result.
